## `8b595f6acd93`: exact-count repair

The canonical “fill hollow plus centers” transformation remains unchanged. The previous packer counted planted motifs, but arms from multiple motifs could accidentally form additional hollow pluses. Reproduced cases included `(7×7, requested 2) → 3`, `(11×9, requested 3) → 4`, and `(16×16, requested 6) → 9` fillable centers.

Placement is now transactional and semantic: a tentative plus is accepted only when the detector sees exactly the previously accepted centers plus the new center. Failed attempts roll back; fallback packing uses the same check; generation raises instead of returning a count mismatch. `self_check` now enforces the declared shape, palette, one-to-six center count, and non-overlapping target neighborhoods while retaining compatibility with canonical partial-plus distractors.

The reusable audit swept every declared feasible `(height, width, count)` combination over four seeds and four sample indices: **9,472 generated cases and 9,472 deterministic replays**, all with exact counts. It also checked 512 default-difficulty cases, all four canonical inputs, and all three degenerate textures.
